up: Return the IC50 values for compounds tested against human B-RAF (CHEMBL ID: CHEMBL5145). For each result, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard IC50 value, standard units, and the literature reference (PubMed ID or DOI).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  a.standard_units AS ic50_units,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5145'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
